title: Five Nights at Freddy's
notes: Plays. The menu and a night of gameplay run at a steady 60 fps on DXVK, GPU about 0.5 ms, on an Apple M1 Pro (macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2). It is a Clickteam Fusion Direct3D 9 game, so DXVK (the automatic and DXVK modes both route Direct3D 9 through it) is the right mode; Wine's own Direct3D also runs but is the slow path. A save is written under the environment, so Continue works on the next launch.

verified.fps: 60 at the menu and through a night on DXVK (Metal HUD), GPU about 0.5 ms

knownIssues.symptom: The game window can sit off centre or unscaled on a display whose logical resolution is not 1280x800.
knownIssues.cause: The game asks Wine for a 1280x800 fullscreen mode; Wine's Mac driver reports success but leaves the Mac display at its current size (measured 2026-09-07: ChangeDisplaySettingsEx returns 0, the display stays put), so a Clickteam game that positions itself for 1280x800 can land off centre. On a display Highball renders at 1728x1117 it scaled to fill.
knownIssues.fix: Set the Mac display to a 16:10 scaled resolution, or play windowed. Not a game or renderer fault.
